OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector. The S3 connector schedules its runs with `S3_INTERVAL` (in seconds).

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: The AWS access key ID used to authenticate against the S3 bucket.

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: The AWS secret access key used to authenticate against the S3 bucket.

S3_BUCKET_NAME.description: The name of the S3 bucket to poll.

S3_REGION.description: The AWS region of the S3 bucket.

S3_ENDPOINT_URL.description: A custom endpoint URL, for S3-compatible services. Leave empty to target Amazon S3.

S3_BUCKET_PREFIXES.description: Comma-separated list of S3 bucket prefixes to process.

S3_AUTHOR.description: The organization name used as `created_by_ref` when the ingested data does not define an author.

S3_MARKING.description: The default TLP marking applied when the ingested data does not define one. Available values are: TLP:CLEAR, TLP:WHITE, TLP:GREEN, TLP:AMBER, TLP:AMBER+STRICT, TLP:RED.

S3_INTERVAL.description: The interval, in seconds, between two polls of the S3 bucket.

S3_ATTACH_ORIGINAL_FILE.description: Whether to attach the original JSON file to the vulnerabilities.

S3_DELETE_AFTER_IMPORT.description: Whether to delete the files from the S3 bucket once they are processed. Set to false to keep them for debugging purposes.

S3_NO_SPLIT_BUNDLES.description: Whether to send the STIX bundles without splitting them.
